_status: Lines are approximate presets routed along main roads between each route's waypoints (scripts/generate-jeep-route-lines.mjs), not official route lines. Stops and km markers still need to be mapped (OpenStreetMap or riding the route with GPS). Confirm each route against Cabanatuan's LPTRP / LTFRB Region III franchise list.
_reportedFareNote: reportedFare values are third-party, pre-September-2026 snapshots. Use only as a sanity check, never as the official fare.
